header.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.TSK_OP
header.description: Task Operational Data Domain Functional Block
header.author: Siemens.SimaticIT

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateTask
command.description: Creates a Task.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateTask
command.description: Updates one or more properties of an existing Task.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteTask
command.description: Deletes an existing Task.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateTaskParameter
command.description: Updates a Task Parameter.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetTaskStatus
command.description: Sets the status of a Task, checking the validity of the transition.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.ForceTaskStatus
command.description: Sets the status of the Task, without checking the validity of the transition.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.ActivateTask
command.description: Applies the verb Activate to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.SuspendTask
command.description: Applies the verb Suspend to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.StartTask
command.description: Applies the verb Start to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.PauseTask
command.description: Applies the verb Pause to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.ResumeTask
command.description: Applies the verb Resume to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.RecoverTask
command.description: Applies the verb Recover to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.FailTask
command.description: Applies the verb Fail to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.CompleteTask
command.description: Applies the verb Complete to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.AbortTask
command.description: Applies the verb Abort to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.CancelTask
command.description: Applies the verb Cancel to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.SkipTask
command.description: Applies the verb Skip to the Task, firing the ActionOnTaskRequested event.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.FreezeTask
command.description: Configures a Task to read-only by setting the attribute IsFrozen to True.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.UnfreezeTask
command.description: Removes the read-only setting from a Task by setting the attribute IsFrozen to False.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetErrorCount
command.description: Sets the value of the Error Count and fires the event ErrorCountChanged.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.ChangeTaskStatusOnAction
command.description: FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY. Changes the Task Status.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.RepeatTask
command.description: Repeats a Task, copying its values and adding 1 to the iteration number of the copy.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.ActivateSequenceStep
command.description: Activates the Tasks for the given Sequence Number within the given Task Flow identifier.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.CheckSequenceStepCompleted
command.description: FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY. Checks if a Sequence Step has been completed.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Commands.RemoveTaskFromTaskFlow
command.description: Resets task flow information in order to remove a Task from a Task Flow.

event.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Events.ActionOnTaskRequested
event.description: The event fired when one of the verbs is applied to the Task.

event.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Events.MessageOnTaskReceived
event.description: The event which permits the receipt of the possible error messages occurred during an operation.

event.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Events.ErrorCountChanged
event.description: The event is fired when Task Error Count is changed calling command SetErrorCount.

event.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Events.ActionOnCompleteWITask
event.description: The event fired to complete WI Task.

event.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.TSK_OP.OPModel.Events.TaskStatusChanged
event.description: Indicates that a status of a task has been changed. It contains information related to the Task. For more information on the event envelope attributes, see TSK_OP Functional Block in the Opcenter EX FN Development and Configuration Guide.
